column3: Refresh expired download addresses without discarding valid partial data
column4:
Context
Jobs store their current URL but have no refresh-address command or durable original-page identity. A renewed signed URL currently becomes a separate job.

Scope
Persist the original page and a refresh correlation identifier; add backend and desktop refresh actions; accept a fresh browser handoff into the existing job.

Acceptance criteria
1. A local fixture expires a URL halfway through a file; a fresh browser URL refreshes the existing job rather than adding a duplicate.
2. Resume retains bytes only when representation identity, size and validators establish the same file; changed content requires an explicit restart.
3. The completed hash matches the fixture and refresh correlation does not accept an unrelated file.

Implementation areas
- crates/protocol/src/lib.rs
- crates/core/src/engine.rs
- crates/core/src/transfer.rs
- extensions/src/shared.ts
- src/App.tsx
